label: Native S&D Design

spec.brief: Build a compact three-route Search & Destroy arena. Give both teams meaningful choices off spawn, keep the middle route fast but exposed, make A more enclosed than B, and avoid a single sightline that controls most rotations.

designPlan.summary: Create three readable east-west routes with a quick exposed center, a tighter northern A lane, and a more open southern B lane, using staggered cover to break cross-map sightlines while preserving spawn choices and rotations.
layout: North route: enclosed A approach with offset walls and two entrances for attack/retake.
Middle route: shortest direct path, intentionally exposed but interrupted by staggered cover so no single angle dominates.
South route: broader B approach with lighter cover, wider rotation space, and multiple engagement angles.
Spawn exits: leave north, center, and south departures available from both fixed spawn groups.
priorities: Maintain one connected navigation component and three viable routes.
Block direct spawn-to-spawn vision and long rotation-controlling sightlines.
Differentiate A as enclosed and B as open.
Use scripted playtests and route traces to correct only high-impact issues.

brief: Build a compact three-route Search & Destroy arena. Give both teams meaningful choices off spawn, keep the middle route fast but exposed, make A more enclosed than B, and avoid a single sightline that controls most rotations.
finishSummary: Completed a compact three-route Search & Destroy arena with fixed-spawn north, center, and south choices; a short exposed mid broken by two cover islands; staggered lane dividers and offset rotation gaps that prevent dominant cross-map sightlines; a three-sided enclosed A pocket; and a wider, more open B approach. Both objectives and all spawns remain valid and reachable in one connected navigation component. Route traces confirm distinct northern and southern approaches, direct spawn-to-spawn LOS is fully blocked, and the final scripted proxy shows balanced site usage with moderate route concentration.

limitations: Scripted seeded proxy. Not human play, combat AI, or a balance oracle.
Standing ground nav only. No jump, crouch, slide, shoot, or damage.
Site choice is travel distance + spawn-anchor exposure + seeded jitter.
Exposure is the fraction of route cells with clear LOS from one or more opposing spawn anchors.
Route concentration is the max fraction of successful rollouts visiting one non-spawn cell.
First contact is the first clear eye-height LOS between the two runners. No firing.
Same seed and rollout count replay the same spawn/jitter sequence.
